# Plug-in compatibility

<!-- Generated by scripts/plugin-matrix.ts from the code: run `npm run docs:plugins` after changing a plug-in function. -->

<!-- known-difference-file: Vendor plug-ins ;; Tabularius runs its own versions of a few plug-in functions and gives ? for the rest; for several plug-ins the vendor function list is incomplete or could not be found, so the product identity, the function names and the results of some named calls are unverified ;; A script that calls a plug-in function not listed as running gets ?, and one that relies on a function whose result is unverified may get a different value from the real plug-in ;; The vendor function reference or a run of the real plug-in for each unverified function -->

A FileMaker plug-in is native code. Tabularius never loads one. Instead it runs its own versions of the functions people use most, and anything else gives what FileMaker gives when the plug-in is not installed: `?`. A script can still ask whether the plug-in is there (`BE_Version = "?"`, `GetAsNumber ( EmailVersion ) < 1.61`).

| Plug-in | How Tabularius handles it | Functions that run | Functions that give `?` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BaseElements (`GyBE`, Goya) | Built in, on for every file; an administrator can turn it off per file | 128 | 32 |
| Troi Text | Built in, on for every file; an administrator can turn it off per file | 1 documented pure function | other documented functions give `?` |
| Troi Dialog | Built in, on for every file; an administrator can turn it off per file | 1 documented pure function | other documented functions give `?` |
| Monkeybread Software (MBS) | Built in; `MBS ( "Name" ; … )` | 443 | every other MBS name gives an MBS error text, and `MBS ( "IsError" )` then says 1 until the next MBS call, within the same script run |
| 360Works Email, DataGuard | Not run | 0 | 12 named functions |
| Any other plug-in | Not run | 0 | every function (calls Tabularius cannot name show as `⟨OWNR:index⟩`) |
| A plug-in written for Tabularius | Runs in a sandbox, switched on per file by an administrator (see [writing-a-plugin.md](writing-a-plugin.md)) | its own | none |

## Monkeybread Software (MBS)

443 functions run, by family:

| Family | Functions |
| --- | --- |
| (version and other) | 8 |
| Container | 4 |
| curl | 27 |
| Dictionary | 30 |
| files | 1 |
| Folders | 1 |
| Hash | 11 |
| js | 9 |
| JSON | 66 |
| List | 50 |
| Math | 36 |
| path | 3 |
| Progress dialog | 9 |
| QuickList | 64 |
| RegEx | 24 |
| Text | 53 |
| Time | 6 |
| Variable | 16 |
| XML | 25 |

Most MBS functions that read or write files, open dialogs, or depend on Apple frameworks give an MBS error. Supported progress dialog calls answer without opening a dialog. `docs/moving-a-solution.md` explains each family's differences from the plug-in.

## Other plug-ins Tabularius knows by name

Every one of these gives `?`:

DataGuard_PostDelete, EmailConnectIMAP, EmailDisconnect, EmailGetNextMessage, EmailLastError, EmailListMailboxes, EmailReadMessages, EmailReadMessageValue, EmailRegister, EmailVersion, IsValidEmail, MBS

The 360Works Email guide describes `IsValidEmail` as a convenience validator but does not publish its acceptance rule. It remains `?`; Tabularius does not infer a replacement result.

A call is also treated as "plug-in not installed" (`?`) when its name starts with one of: `BE_`, `TrFile_`, `TrText_`, `TrURL_`, `TURL_`, `TrSerial_`, `Serial_`, `Dlg_`, `Dial_`, `Actr_`, `SMTPit_`, `DataGuard_`, `PCQB_`, `PCOL_`, `EvaluateGroovy`, `RegisterGroovy`, or when it is a call the file reader could only name by its owner and index. Names in the 360Works Email list: dataguard_postdelete, emailconnectimap, emaildisconnect, emailgetnextmessage, emaillasterror, emaillistmailboxes, emailreadmessages, emailreadmessagevalue, emailregister, emailversion, isvalidemail.

## Surveyed vendor plug-ins

The function inventory and behavior classes are summarized in [the plug-in ecosystem audit](audits/audit-plugin-ecosystem.md). These rows record the public-documentation review; a `?` is FileMaker's missing-plug-in result.

| Plug-in | Functions implemented here | Documented functions not implemented here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Troi Text | `TrText_GetLine` | Other documented text, XML, clipboard and spelling functions give `?`; named results beyond the individual function page are not inferred. |
| Troi Dialog | `Dial_CenterPointOfRect` | Other documented dialog, screen, notification, preference and timing functions give `?`. |
| Troi File | none | File/path/hash/encoding operations give `?`; no file permission is granted by this compatibility layer. |
| Troi Activator | none | Trigger, schedule, HTTP, and system-control operations give `?`. |
| “Troi Auto” label | none | Unverified product identity; no alias to Troi Activator is assumed. |
| Troi URL and Serial | none | Network, serial-device and platform-dependent operations give `?`. |
| 360Works Email | none | Mail, mailbox, network, state, file and dialog operations give `?`; `IsValidEmail` remains `?` because its documented rule is unspecified. |
| 360Works ScriptMaster | none | Arbitrary Groovy/Java, registration, state, clipboard, SQL, file, network and shell operations give `?`. |
| 360Works Scribe | none | Document/file processing and text-diff/regex operations give `?` until their exact behavior is established. |
| 360Works SuperContainer companion | none | Server/network, filesystem, container, certificate and dialog operations give `?`. |
| 360Works Zip | none | Unverified: no current public 360Works Zip function reference was found. |
| Productivity Tools | none | Unverified: the supplied product name did not resolve to a specific FileMaker plug-in or public function reference. |
| DataGuard, SMTPit, PCQB, PCOL | none | Existing recognized names and prefixes give `?`; see the audit for the boundary of public documentation reviewed. |

## Adding one

To bring another plug-in over, write a replacement as a Tabularius plug-in (JavaScript or WebAssembly) following [writing-a-plugin.md](writing-a-plugin.md), or ask for a built-in pack. A pack needs a sample file made with the real plug-in so its results can be checked; none is guessed.
